title: Focus order drawn as a path
blurb: A canvas draws links, fields and buttons, and over them a numbered line through every Tab stop in the order the Tab key visits them. Steps that go against reading order are orange. Stops that aren't in the picture are listed in a red strip.
question: Can a canvas work out the Tab order of the elements it draws and draw it over them, and does the path stay right when the picture is rearranged?
result: In Chromium 157 a rule of about 30 lines gave the same order as the real Tab key in the 5 arrangements tried. The positions come from getBoundingClientRect(), which follows the picture. An element that isn't drawn is still a Tab stop.
